invariants.rationale: instantTime is likely a required identifier for an update operation and should not be null.
partitionPath defines the partition being updated, and a null value may not be valid for partitioned tables.
fileId identifies the file to be updated and should be non-null to target a specific file.
Updating a file should involve at least one new record, so the map should not be null or empty.
A merge/update operation requires a reference to the data file being merged.
